name: admin-worker
description: Admin Worker with fail-closed Tencent runtime E2E gate and deterministic redacted failure marker

scripts.cf:build: node --check src/guard.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/production-superguard.js && node --check src/protection.js && node --check src/superguard.js && node --check src/tencent-executor.js && node --check ../scripts/tencent-postdeploy-e2e.mjs && node --check ../scripts/tencent-production-attestation-verify.mjs && node tests/tencent-executor-contract.mjs && node tests/tencent-cloudflare-secret-presence.mjs && node ../scripts/tencent-production-attestation-verify.mjs preview-marker && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('openapi.json','utf8'))"
scripts.cf:ci:preview: node ../scripts/cloudflare-receipt-runner.mjs admin preview npm run cf:ci:preview:inner
scripts.cf:ci:deploy: node ../scripts/cloudflare-receipt-runner.mjs admin deploy npm run cf:ci:deploy:inner
scripts.cf:preview: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler deploy
